central_question: Can nitrogen environments adjacent to isolated nickel sites improve reactant access during dilute-CO2 electroreduction?
claims_and_limits: Yun et al. report pyridinic-N enrichment and propose reversible CO2 adduct formation and a local desorption-re-adsorption relay near Ni–Nx sites.
The authors discuss dilute feeds motivated by 3–15% CO2 industrial flue gas; selective CO conversion is a laboratory finding.
No industrial full-exhaust stability, system energy balance or commercial economics is established; a related pending patent is disclosed.

visual.shared_motif: Olive laboratory flow cell and conceptual nickel/nitrogen catalyst neighborhood; inner separates scarce feed, local relay and open industrial questions.
visual.status: Conceptual molecular illustration, not an atomically exact structural model or plant-ready system.
